leads.name: Tetrameles (Somphong) of Huai Pu Phatthana village
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees list, register id 2017-11
leads.note: Karen village tree with buttresses about 2 m high, register girth 30 m is a buttress spread (cleared). Remote hill road Huai Pu Phatthana to Yang Kham Nu; searches found nothing on this village, no dated sighting, lifecheck NONE, no public-access source. No photo or exact pin in reach.

leads.name: Thousand-year Assam tea tree, Phan Pi tea forest park, Doi Chang to Doi Wawi ridge
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees list, register id 2017-40
leads.note: Register: found Nov 2005, about 2.05 m girth, called Thailand's largest tea tree; a park exists per register text, but searches found no page confirming the park, opening or the tree today. lifecheck NONE. Register coordinate is ridge-level only. Doi Chang/Doi Wawi are in Mae Suai district, a long drive from Chiang Rai town. Lead: needs access and an observation.

leads.name: Beleric (Samo Phiphek) at Wat Kio Phrao
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees list, register id 2018-19
leads.note: Register coordinate was a placeholder, cleared. Temple tree in Tambon Chan Chawa Tai, Mae Chan, said discovered at the temple's founding 1867; height 50 m implausible (cleared by us). Searches found nothing on it. Temple visit free, dress code expected; no coordinate or photo: lead, find the temple pin on OSM.
